name: Castillo Hotel Son Vida
positioning: Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca: a hotel in a 13th-century castle in the Son Vida neighbourhood above the Bay of Palma, part of Arabella Golf Resort Mallorca
best_for: Golfers who want a base at Arabella Golf Resort Mallorca
Travelers who want a historic castle stay with bay views, minutes from Palma

facts.text: The hotel is set in the Son Vida neighbourhood.
The hotel is just minutes from Palma and surrounded by nature.
The hotel is part of Arabella Golf Resort Mallorca, with easy access to renowned golf courses.
Arabella Golf Resort Mallorca has four golf courses.
The spa has four treatment rooms.
The hotel has an indoor spa pool and a large outdoor pool.
Rooms and suites reflect Mallorca's indigenous design, from earthy hues to intricate patterns.
The Palma Suite has an open-space design, a standalone bath, a rain shower, a sauna and two terraces with Mallorca views.
The Royal Suite has custom crimson and cream tones and a separate bedroom and living area.
The castle hosts art exhibitions, guided art tours and cultural activities.
Hiking and cycling routes run through the pine-scented surroundings of Son Vida.
Es Balcó de Son Vida serves Mediterranean product-driven cuisine with a contemporary Mallorcan identity.

highlights.text: The hotel is housed in a 13th-century castle overlooking the Bay of Palma.
Originally a private palace dating to the thirteenth century, the hotel first opened in 1961 and was an instant jet-set address.
The golf resort is home to Mallorca's oldest golf course, a two-time host of the Balearic Open.
The Villa Suite spans two floors, with four bedrooms, a private pool terrace, a private wellness center and a kitchen.
Rooms overlook the bay of Palma, lush greenery and the Mediterranean Sea.

considerations.text: Sa Font Pool Bar operates during the summer months.
Palma de Mallorca Airport is about 15 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the hillside location requires transportation to reach Palma city center.
